criteria.text: Mobile connects to its paired session transport through the Cloudflare relay with **no** Tailscale dependency, and the existing SSE/PTY/prompt contract is unchanged.
criteria.test_id: issue-1373-c1: an owned PTY carries text in both directions over the relay
criteria.live_test_id: relays real engine PTY output and denies another project and user
criteria.reason: Loopback relay plus real API/engine passed; hosted Cloudflare and remote iOS network path remain unverified.

criteria.text: Auth boundary preserved: device-token/cloud-bearer validation unchanged; the relay never sees or needs a raw model-held bearer; fail closed on invalid/expired/revoked tokens.
criteria.test_id: issue-1373-c2: revoking an established uplink bearer takes the Mac offline

criteria.text: Relay endpoints are authenticated and tenant/project-scoped; opaque IDs; cross-user/cross-project fail closed.
criteria.test_id: serves scoped SSE from the relay hub and drops foreign sessions

criteria.text: Disconnect/relay-drop recovery is idempotent — resume the same session or show a durable actionable failure, never duplicate.
criteria.test_id: reconnects after a drop and re-runs hello + devices

criteria.text: Explicit kill switch; disabling the relay falls back to the existing paired path with no data loss.
criteria.test_id: issue-1373-c5: relay kill switch keeps the saved pairing and routes PTY direct

criteria.text: Observability records operator/session/relay state + sanitized failure reason, no credentials/host paths/transcript content.
criteria.test_id: issue-1373-c6: storage failures expose a sanitized relay diagnostic

criteria.text: Threat-model review + a negative test from a second user/project proving denial.
criteria.live_test_id: relays real engine PTY output and denies another project and user
